title: RWANG Edge Contract
description: Normative schema for one versioned Edge Contract under docs/registry/edge-contracts/<predicate>@<semver>.yaml (CR-2026-08-20-01 A2 §2.2). Contract definitions live ONLY here — never per node. contract_version is the only version field name.

contract_version.description: Semver. Breaking changes (endpoint types, direction, predicate meaning, required fields, cardinality, ID namespace) require a major bump plus migration evidence (RWG-205 otherwise).

predicate.description: Canonical predicate set (graph schema 2.0.0). 'stale' is a status, not a predicate. 'derived_from' is reserved and not yet active.

from_type.description: Allowed source node types. Note: 'implements' contracts MUST list code_file only.

labels.description: Display-only readings of the SAME edge (excluded from semantic_hash). Inverse navigation is a query — never a second reverse edge.

payload_schema.description: JSON Schema for the edge payload; empty object means no payload allowed

cardinality.description: Structural multiplicity bound, e.g. 0..*, 0..1, 1..*. Core cardinality is structural; requiredness (e.g. 'every complex feature needs a diagram') belongs to the profile, not the contract.

semantic_hash.description: sha256 of the normalized contract (SPEC-5DRIVEN-01 §2.3: drop labels/provenance/comments, sort keys, canonical JSON, SHA-256)

provenance.description: Audit metadata (CR §2.5). Never participates in semantic_hash or exact-set reconciliation.
